name: Vachika AI Chat Assistant
author: vachikaai

sections.description:
Privacy Policy & Terms of Service

Vachika AI Chat Assistant relies on our third-party service to power the chatbot functionality.
* Privacy Policy: https://vachika.com/privacy-policy/
* Terms of Service: https://vachika.com/terms-condition/

Vachika AI Chat Assistant is the easiest way to add an intelligent customer support agent to your website. It learns from your website content and answers visitor questions instantly, 24/7.

Key Features:
* Auto-Training: Just installing the plugin connects your site to our AI engine.
* Instant Answers: Responds to user queries using your website’s content.
* Lead Capture: Collects visitor details when human help is needed.
* Zero Coding: No complex setup required. Just install and activate.

How it Works:
1. Install this plugin.
2. Go to the Vachika Dashboard in your WP Admin.
3. Click “Add Website to Dashboard” (it auto-detects your URL).
4. Done! The bot will appear on your site immediately.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/vachika-chatbot directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Use the Vachika Chatbot menu to check your connection status.
sections.faq:
Do I need an account?

Yes, you need a Vachika AI account to manage the chatbot’s training and view chat logs. The plugin will guide you to create one.

Is it free?

We offer a Free Trial and a Starter Plan. Visit vachika.com for pricing details.
sections.changelog:

  • Enqueued scripts properly using wp_enqueue_script.
  • Fixed text domain issues.

1.3.4

  • Improved auto-connection logic.
  • Added client-side connectivity check for local environments.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
